entry.content:
Present Day, Present Time...
Hello, I am a machine learning researcher and especially focus on representation learning.

Personal Information

  • Name: So Hasegawa
  • Age: 28

Background

  • 2021 ~ : machine learning researcher at Fujitsu
    • My research is focused on representation learning that involves self-supervised learning and generative models

  • 2018 ~ 2021: software engineer at Fujitsu

    • I had mainly two jobs. First, I worked on developing software products. I have developed the deep learing modules in the product. Second, I worked on resolving customers' problems related to machine learning. I have worked on the problems of speaker diarization, semantic segmentation and object detection.
    • Besides my work, I have done experiments on automatic character generation as my hobby. Please visit my blog I have written about the results of some experiments.

  • 2016 ~ 2018: MEng in Electronics at Kyoto University

    • I worked on the study of thin μ-Si/Si solar cells with photonic crystals. I optimized the structure of photonic crystals using generating algorithm or machine learning and processed solar cells from Si substrate besed on the design.

  • 2012 ~ 2016: BEng in Electrical and Electronic Engineering at Kyoto University

Personal Projects

  • Automatic line art colorization

    • Various Implementions of line art colorization with hints and without hints.

  • AwesomeAnimeResearch

    • A massive collection of machine learning papers and projects related to anime, illustration and comic.

  • KawaiiGenerator

    • Various implementations of deep learning tasks related to anime

Skills

  • Deep learning

    • Framework: Pytorch, Keras, Chainer
    • I have worked on the following fields
      • Computer vision: Image generation, Style transfer, Video processing, Object detection, Semantic segmentation, 3D (point cloud)
      • Speech processing: Voice conversion, Speech synthesis, Speaker recognition, Speech enhancement
      • Natural Language Processing: Langauge models, Text generation

  • Low-level Programming

    • Emulator: NES, GB, CGB (implementations by Go)
    • Clang compiler

  • Programming Language

    • Main: Python, Go
    • Sub: C, Rust, Haskell, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS

  • Software Development

    • I have experienced team development and have used the following tools
      • OS: Linux(Ubuntu, CentOS), MacOS
      • Container: Docker, Docker-compose, Kubernetes
      • Version management: Git, Gitlab, Github
      • DB: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
      • Others: Nodejs, gRPC, Nginx, RabbitMQ

Interests

  • Machine learning
  • Art: I love all kinds of art, especially post-impressionism and retro design
  • DTM: I love not only composing but also sound creating

Talks

  • The fundamental and applications of Generative Adversarial Networks
